audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill / Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Skill / Olaf / Olaf, giving Olaf the late game and calling levels 1-3 even, and diff was set to 'FAV' on a lane the same entry rates 8.5/10 difficulty and 47.78% win rate.
audit.why: The mirror audit (olaf__vladimir) resolved this as Olaf owning every pre-item stage, Skill at first item and Vladimir at two-plus items — Olaf is the champion who falls off, not the one who scales. Vladimir's win condition on this page is already 'anti-heal, pool, and out-scale him', so the old chart contradicted its own prose.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Olaf / Olaf / Olaf / Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Vladimir in phases[N].side and win[N] as one paired atomic group, with whys[0]-[5] rewritten to match and diff corrected from FAV to HARD.

audit.whatIsWrong: First item and two items were both written as Olaf stages.
audit.why: Reckless Swing is flat true damage on a 325-range melee hit and Ragnarok is a flat resist/immunity steroid — neither scales with items the way Riftmaker plus Crimson Pact does. The two-item window is Vladimir's, which is exactly what spikes[3].text already says.
audit.corrected: Rows 5 and 6 set to Skill and Vladimir; whys[5] rewritten so the first-item row reads as the coin-flip it is.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text called a missed Undertow 'a huge window' and never mentioned that Olaf gets the axe back.
audit.why: Riot's Q text is explicit: if Olaf picks up the axe, the cooldown is reset. A dodged axe is only a window while he is walking to retrieve it — that walk is the actual trade window, and it is the single most exploitable behaviour in the matchup. Undertow also reduces Armor and Move Speed from 1000 range, and Berserker Rage gives him Attack Speed and Life Steal as his health drops, so chipping him without Grievous Wounds makes him stronger. Ragnarok grants immunity to disables while he keeps attacking, so Sanguine Pool's slow and Tides of Blood's slow do nothing during it.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now states the pickup reset and the 9s cooldown and names the walk as the trade window; phases[4].why and whys[4] now state what Ragnarok's immunity actually turns off.

audit.why: Undertow at a flat 9s is the punishable cooldown; Ragnarok is 100s at rank 1.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — Olaf can't stick without a landed axe.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Undertow slows from 1000 range and resets.

edits.before: Level 2 stays skill: your poke trades with his missed-axe windows.
edits.after: Level 2 is his — a picked-up axe refunds the cooldown and he re-throws.

edits.before: Level 3 remains even as juking Undertow denies his engage.
edits.after: Level 3 is his — Reckless Swing true damage ignores your MR.

edits.before: At 6 the phase is even — Ragnarok deters your all-in but you can kite it.
edits.after: At 6 Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking you.

edits.before: First item a fed Olaf's true damage during Ragnarok wins the duel, favouring him.
edits.after: First item is a coin-flip: your Riftmaker sustain finally matches his true damage.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hemoplague resets fights, but Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he attacks — your slows stop nothing, so kite, do not fight.

edits.before: Olaf's whole game is landing Undertow — if his axe hits, the slow lets him run you down with Reckless Swing lifesteal, but a missed axe is a huge window; pool the axe or juke it and his all-in falls apart until it's back up.
edits.after: Olaf's whole game is landing Undertow — the axe cuts your armour and move speed at 1000 range, and picking it up resets the 9s cooldown, so a dodged axe is only a window if he cannot walk to it. Trade in the second he is walking for the axe.

notes: Left alone as unverified, matching the mirror: whether Sanguine Pool's untargetability can dodge a Reckless Swing already mid-cast, or only prevents it being cast on you. Nothing on the page depends on the distinction as written now. Also note the packet header disagrees with itself — games is 1270 at the top of the brief and 316 inside the packet, with the 47.78% quoted against 316.
